method.pool_constraint: Action heads only from Val Action Pool; objects only from Val Object Pool; multiword actions add only observed verb particles
method.ranking_score: 0.8 * word cosine + 0.2 * best Val example cosine + relation bonus (0.12 synonym/morphology; 0.04 broader term)
method.ranking_priority: First selected-sense synonyms/morphology (tier 0), then broader hypernyms (tier 1), then embedding-only results (tier 2); score ranks within a tier
method.multiword_actions: Only verb + dependency-prt particles observed in an actual validation caption; normalized head is in original Val Action Pool
method.context: Original train caption; up to three stored pool examples for single lemmas; all observed occurrences for phrasal verbs
method.val_example_selection: Highest train-caption cosine; for selected-sense synonyms, 0.7 train-caption cosine + 0.3 source-sense-definition cosine
method.sense_selection: Highest cosine between original caption embedding and source WordNet sense definition embedding
method.sense_filter: Exclude lexical matches supported exclusively by an unselected source sense
method.antonym_filter: Exclude candidates whose WordNet senses are direct antonyms of any source sense, in either direction
method.threshold_scope: Uncalibrated word-cosine review flag, never an acceptance probability
method.global_vs_caption: Global term rows use up to three original train example captions; per-caption rankings use that exact caption
limitations: WordNet sense selection is heuristic and can be wrong.
Embedding proximity can reflect related or opposing concepts; WordNet does not cover every antonym.
Hypernyms lose specificity and are not interchangeable synonyms.
Source typos, wrong POS, abbreviations and proper names can produce weak candidates.
Pool membership does not prove pixel grounding, action preservation or timestamp equivalence.
